owner_and_capability: Settings Platform publishes its own records (decision A of #4004, config family of #4085): models/config moves unchanged to modules/settings/records, classified as the owner's port, and the root binds it directly instead of through modules/settings/compose/vocabulary, which is deleted. The owner compositions that read settings keys or the retained settings service stop doing so: Class Day View, Device Fleet, Process Device Scan, Facilities, School Setup and Workforce take narrow, key-free ports (write scope, slot-list settings, scan settings, device configuration loader, room history settings, sick note retention window, school setup settings, checkout switch keys) that the root binds to the Settings Platform (api/settings_bindings.go, api/device_fleet_settings.go). Workforce's two legacy schedule adapters, which map the Settings Platform's legacy work-schedule records to the Workforce capability and to the time-tracking rows, move into the root unchanged.
affected_tables: None: the same settings are read with the same keys and the same Workforce capability calls; only the packages that name the keys and records move.
atomic_cutover: One PR. models/config is renamed to modules/settings/records (package records, content unchanged except Definition.Validate split into three helpers in the same order of checks) and every importer follows the path. Each owner composition's settings binding moves verbatim into the root as the implementation of a port the composition declares; nil settings keep their previous meaning (unbound write scope and scan settings, panics on required dependencies). The device online window, the display tenant facts and the room history prefetch keep the same resolve-or-default helpers through settingsCompose. The workforce legacy schedule repositories keep their sql.ErrNoRows mapping through workforceCompose.LegacyWorkTimeModelNotFound. The 13 keys leave legacy.jsonl.
tests: modules/classday/compose: the slot-list suites over api.ClassDaySlotListSettings wrapping the same stubs, assertions unchanged.
modules/devicescan/compose: the checkout-time pass-through suite over the ScanSettings port; api: the device configuration suite moved from the composition, assertions unchanged.
api: the device online-window suite moved from modules/devicefleet/compose/httpadapter; the display routes over NewDisplayTenantFacts.
modules/facilities/compose/httpadapter: the rooms route suites with the root's room history settings, toggling the same settings service.
modules/facilities/compose/legacy: the side-effect suite with the switch keys passed in, assertions unchanged.
modules/schoolsetup/compose: the wizard suite over api.SchoolSetupSettings; modules/workforce/http/timetracking: the sick note retention suite over the window port.
modules/workforce/internal/application/timetracking: the time-tracking suites over the root's legacy schedule repositories and adapters.
api: TestFullProductionRouterGolden; test ratchets and internal/architecture; scripts/backend-architecture.sh check and validate-ticket --all; scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development.
